text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted Silence Suzuka looking restless.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Actually…… lately I feel like someone's been watching me the entire time…… and so……
*staaaaaaare*……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking around…… I spotted Special Week peeking at us from behind the school building.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Awawawa~~!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You startled me…… It was Spe-chan watching me, wasn't it.
But why……?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry……
To tell the truth…… the other day, some classmates were talking about you, Suzuka-san……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They said they saw you doing something unusual out in the rain.
They were wondering what happened to the usually cool Suzuka-san……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ……I thought maybe you were stressed out. Because, well, you couldn't run in the rain……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But back in our room, you acted completely normal as always…… So that made me even more worried……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I ended up secretly following you when you were alone……
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
……So that was it.
Thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was just trying out a clear-sky ritual I was taught. So there's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so!?
Whew, what a relief~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
……Though.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, if there's ever anything on your mind,
I want you to come and ask me right away…… I guess.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Wouldn't that be a nuisance……?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If you bottle it up and fret alone, you'll end up stressed out yourself, right……?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So don't hold back, okay……?
I'll…… ask Spe-chan anything, too. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Suzuka-san……
Yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, actually……
There's just one more thing on my mind……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Could you show me your clear-sky ritual, Suzuka-san?
Ever since hearing about it, I've been dying to see it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?
Isn't that a bit too sudden……?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is that…… a no?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
……When you look at me with those eyes……
……Alright, fine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But it's sunny today, so performing it out of the blue
might be a little embarrassing……
choice_data_list: Why don't the two of you do it together?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
With Spe-chan...? 
Yes, okay... If that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two moved to the grounds,
enjoying their ritual praying for sunny skies.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! This is super fun, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It is.
Doing it together feels refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Suzuka-san!
All that gloominess is gone, and I feel totally refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, praying for sunny skies feels pretty unexpected
coming from you, Suzuka-san. I kind of thought you wouldn't rely on something like that...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so.
...Though, I don't think it's bad once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because today, it wasn't the sky, but Spe-chan's heart that—
